title: Adaption AI Launches Invent API for 37% More Diverse Synthetic Data
summary:
Researchers and developers can now use a public interface to create large-scale AI training sets from simple textual descriptions. Adaption AI has opened API access for its Invent system, which automates the production of post-training datasets in minutes with a few lines of code. The tool allows users to generate high-quality data for new model capabilities without needing any seed examples, solving the constraints of a zero-data regime.

A technical report accompanying the launch shows that Invent outperforms frontier models including GPT-5.6, Claude Opus 5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro across 8 task types. The system delivers 17% higher quality and 19% greater sample diversity than these APIs, with the diversity advantage increasing to 37% when generating 20,000 samples. While competitors like Claude showed decreased variety at that scale, the Invent API maintained 0.0% duplicates.
